title: The sphere-covering bound in Lean
description: A Lean 4 formalization, against Mathlib v4.34.1, of the classical sphere-covering lower bound on the covering number K_q(n,R). The archive checks eight instances, including K_7(9,4) >= 221, determines several small covering numbers exactly, including K_2(7,1) = 16, and exhibits a 12-word covering giving K_2(6,1) <= 12. It does not prove upper bounds for the eight instances, and K_2(6,1) >= 11 remains conditional.
